title: Figures 13-14: PLA/PEG biodegradable polymers graphic and dots of hydrogel
description: A promotional graphic reading "PLA/PEG Biodegradable Polymers" over capsule images and faint chemical structures is captioned "Figure 13. Biodegradable Polymers Based on Copolymers of Polylactic Acid and Polyethylene Glycol". Below, a close-up photograph of small translucent droplets is captioned "Figure 14. Dots of Hydrogel". The page covers the polyethylene glycol and hydrogels sections of the biomaterials report.
